title: unified 80-unit offline teacher label document: one-layer Reference enumeration only; per-unit teacherVersion, rank and hard-exclusion labels; S4 information units labeled but not pairable; manual locked audit-only; no R8 selector, no v1 shadow, no production kernel, no teacher valueVector in production features, no teacher-written Chinese reasoning.

authority.claimDetail: freezes the unified 80-unit offline teacher label document shape, enumeration rules, sorting and canonical hash rules; the offline enumeration harness and the label artifact are NOT generated yet; no production closure ever loads teacher code; this contract is not an implementation claim.

corpusMapping.unitIndexRule: behaviorQualityCorpus.units is the single authority for the 80 unit identities; the label document units array must have the same unitId set, and each label unit sourceHash must equal the matching split unit sourceHash.

partitions.enumeration: reference-value-evaluator-v2.mjs evaluateRawCase(fixture.input) per fixture; enumerated selected must equal fixture.expected.selectedCandidateId, otherwise labelStatus = EXPECTATION_MISMATCH_FAILED
reference-value-evaluator-v2.mjs evaluateRawCase({ caseId, mode, playerLockedCandidateId, candidates }) per case

fieldRules.sourceHash: must equal split unit sourceHash (canonicalUnitHash of the exact source case object per BehaviorProviderQualitySplitV1.generation.serialization)
fieldRules.teacherVersion: enum RVE2_ORACLE_EXPECTATION | RVE2_KERNEL | RVE3_RAW; fixed per corpus partition
fieldRules.mode: case mode: auto | manual; all oracle fixtures and v3 raw cases are auto; exactly one kernel unit (ref-manual-locked) is manual
fieldRules.selected: teacher selected candidateId; null ONLY when labelStatus is EXPECTATION_MISMATCH_FAILED or GENERATION_ERROR
fieldRules.pareto: teacher Pareto candidateId set, UTF-16 ascending; recorded for S4 information units too
fieldRules.excluded: ineligible candidateIds (v2: legal === false or hardExclusionCodes non-empty; v3: eligible === false), UTF-16 ascending
fieldRules.eligible: eligible candidateIds (v2: legal !== false and hardExclusionCodes empty; v3: eligible === true), UTF-16 ascending
fieldRules.rankByCandidateId: auto only: rank0 selected, rank1 other pareto members, rank2 eligible dominated; excluded never ranked; manual units MUST have empty object; keys candidateId, values 0|1|2
fieldRules.hardExclusionByCandidateId: per candidateId boolean: true iff excluded by hard exclusion (v2: hardExclusionCodes non-empty; v3: exclusionReasons contains a non-ILLEGAL entry); pure ILLEGAL-only exclusion is false while still listed in excluded
fieldRules.informationValuePresent: true iff any candidate of the unit carries non-empty informationGroups
fieldRules.notPairableReasons: closed enum [INFORMATION_FEATURE_MISSING]; MUST contain INFORMATION_FEATURE_MISSING when informationValuePresent is true; MUST be empty when informationValuePresent is false

enumerationRules.oneLayerReferenceEnumeration: the offline labeling harness calls evaluateRawCase exactly once per unit; no secondary selection, no re-ranking, no AB comparison, no production kernel involvement
enumerationRules.oracleExpectationCheck: RVE2_ORACLE_EXPECTATION units: enumerated selected must equal fixture.expected.selectedCandidateId; mismatch => labelStatus EXPECTATION_MISMATCH_FAILED, selected null, rank empty; the mismatch unit still keeps teacherVersion/mode/sourceHash
enumerationRules.rankDerivation: rank0 = selected; rank1 = pareto minus selected; rank2 = eligible minus pareto; pairs derive only across ranks (rankLabelDerivationV1); same-rank candidates never pair; candidateId enumeration order is UTF-16 ascending
enumerationRules.manualRule: manual/PLAYER_LOCKED units: labelStatus MANUAL_LOCKED_AUDIT_ONLY; selected = teacher locked candidate; rankByCandidateId MUST be empty; they never enter top1 or pairwise training, only mechanical-legality and hard-exclusion audit
enumerationRules.s4InformationRule: S4 information units still record teacher selected/pareto/alternatives/excluded/eligible, but informationValuePresent true forces notPairableReasons = [INFORMATION_FEATURE_MISSING]; downstream PairedDistillationDataset MUST NOT use their pair or top1
enumerationRules.hardExclusionRule: excluded candidates never enter rank or pairs; hardExclusionByCandidateId is the single audit source for hardExclusionConsistency == 1.0
enumerationRules.noValueVector: teacher valueVector/causalFacts/informationBreakdown/score fields are NEVER copied into the label document; only the enumerated identity sets and rank/exclusion maps above
enumerationRules.noChineseReasoning: teacher output never generates Chinese reasoning text; player-facing reasoning is produced exclusively from DecisionContributionTraceV1 contribution traces

canonicalSerializationV1.rule: compact UTF8 JSON (no insignificant whitespace); object keys sorted recursively by UTF-16 code unit ascending; array order preserved; -0 normalized to 0; NaN/Infinity rejected (validator FATAL, never serialized as null)

sortAndHashRules.arraySort: pareto/alternatives/excluded/eligible sorted by UTF-16 code unit ascending; rankByCandidateId and hardExclusionByCandidateId are maps (key order irrelevant, canonicalized by key sort)
sortAndHashRules.labelsHashRule: SHA256(UTF8(canonicalSerializationV1({ schemaVersion: "OfflineTeacherLabelingV1", units: [...label units sorted by unitId UTF-16 ascending...] }))); lowercase hexadecimal
sortAndHashRules.sourceHashRule: per-unit sourceHash equals BehaviorProviderQualitySplitV1 behaviorQualityCorpus.units[unitId].sourceHash; no self-invented hash

forbidden.name: r8Selector
forbidden.description: no R8 selector or any legacy selection pipeline may be loaded or called while labeling

forbidden.name: v1Shadow
forbidden.description: reference-value-evaluator.mjs (v1) is shadow code; forbidden in the offline labeling closure

forbidden.name: productionKernel
forbidden.description: production kernel/provider/adapter modules are never loaded by the labeling harness

forbidden.name: teacherInProductionClosure
forbidden.description: teacher code is offline-only; production closure never imports it

forbidden.name: teacherValueVectorInFeatures
forbidden.description: teacher valueVector never becomes a production feature; production input is BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1 feature vectors only

forbidden.name: teacherWrittenReasoning
forbidden.description: Chinese reasoning text is generated only from DecisionContributionTraceV1; teacher output never writes player reasoning

forbidden.name: labelFieldWhitelist
forbidden.description: label units contain exactly the 15 perUnitFields; extra fields are rejected by the schema

semanticChecks.description: label units unitId set equals BehaviorProviderQualitySplitV1 behaviorQualityCorpus.units unitId set; partition counts 54/20/6
every label unit sourceHash equals the matching split unit sourceHash

auto units: eligible and excluded partition the case candidate set and are disjoint; pareto is a subset of eligible; selected is in pareto; alternatives = pareto minus selected; rank key set equals eligible; rank0 = selected; rank1 = pareto minus selected; rank2 = eligible minus pareto
pareto/alternatives/excluded/eligible are UTF-16 ascending and duplicate-free
RVE2_ORACLE_EXPECTATION units: enumerated selected equals fixture.expected.selectedCandidateId or labelStatus is EXPECTATION_MISMATCH_FAILED with selected null
informationValuePresent equals (any candidate of the unit carries non-empty informationGroups); true forces notPairableReasons = [INFORMATION_FEATURE_MISSING]; false forces empty
mode manual implies labelStatus MANUAL_LOCKED_AUDIT_ONLY, selected non-null, rankByCandidateId empty; manual units never enter top1/pairwise
label units contain none of valueVector/causalFacts/informationBreakdown/score/candidateValue fields (schema additionalProperties false enforces)
labelsHash computed by sortAndHashRules.labelsHashRule is reproducible from the label document itself

selfCheck.purpose: positive examples are validated at #/$defs/unit level of OfflineTeacherLabelingV1.schema.json and MUST pass; negative examples are validated at the same level and MUST be rejected; the full label artifact additionally requires exactly 80 units (unitCount const 80, units minItems/maxItems 80); set-conservation, UTF-16 ordering and expectation consistency are semantic checks executed by the offline labeling harness, not by JSON Schema

validation.schemaBinding: OfflineTeacherLabelingV1.schema.json is the label ARTIFACT schema (mirrors the BehaviorImmediateFeatureV1.json vs its output schema precedent): it validates the future 80-unit label artifact document, not this contract document; this contract document is the frozen specification and carries its own selfCheck instead
validation.selfCheckRequirement: all selfCheck.positive entries MUST validate against #/$defs/unit; all selfCheck.negative entries MUST be rejected by #/$defs/unit
validation.semanticCheckRequirement: semanticChecks are executed by the offline labeling harness and must all pass before the label artifact is pinned
validation.noStageCommit: this batch creates the two files only; no stage, no commit
